title: Chapter 7011: Count Me In

Chapter 7011: Count Me In

Chapter 7011: Count Me In

“Click!” The two brothers disassembled and reassembled into a single fortress. Magically enough, their silver and golden lights combined like the yin and yang, forming a magical domain.

“This is possible?” The crowd was surprised to see this.

“You’re not scaring anyone!” Amethyst unleashed more liquid from his gourd: “Activate!”

As he poured his immortal energy into the gourd, the liquid enveloped the newly created domain. Other immortals retreated from its massive radius.

“You’re courting death.” The two brothers were furious and recalled their domain’s power into the fortress.

It grew larger and descended, crushing space and time. This created a terrible black hole.

“This is insane!” An immortal shouted.

“You two are the ones courting death.” Snowdragon Immortal unleashed her blizzard against them.

“Crack!” It could freeze the dao of immortals. When the cold combined with the heat from Amethyst’s liquid, it caused cracks to appear on the fortress.

“That’s impressive.” Other immortals became impressed.

“Since when do the puny alliances dare to bluster?” Someone spoke and heralded the autumn wind and leaves.

Somehow, it erased both the scorching liquid and chilling blizzard.

“Now!” The fortress brothers released a yin-yang world toward the combatants. The core of the blast became a black hole.

“Boom!” Snowdragon and Amethyst staggered backward after the impact, feeling their vitality churning.

“Show yourself, Autumn Wind!” Snowdragon was furious and let her blizzard run wild.

“Please take it easy!” Mo Xiangsheng shouted upon seeing the rampaging blizzard.

She actually listened and controlled the blizzard to only affect the sky.

“Snowdragon, this is getting out of control, trading lives over a treasure?” A mysterious wind answered - a golden immortal belonging to Vagabond Alliance.

Some said that Autumn Wind’s origin was an assassin or a natural disaster turned immortal. All in all, his winds brought leaves and withering.

“When it’s a fight, it’ll be a fight to the death.” Snowdragon’s words pricked listeners’ ears.

“I’m not backing down today.” Amethyst laughed.

“Enough, this is not the time or place for you to play around. Our race will allow any allies to share the spoils in Dusk. Decide now.” Golden Machine Immortal uttered coldly, changing his stance.

The fortress race was the strongest force in Dusk currently since they had a primordial immortal and Heavencrush. It appeared wise to join them instead of opposing them.

“Hahaha, I don’t buy your scheme, this land already has a master.” Amethyst laughed.

“You wish to monopolize it?” Silver Machine Immortal sneered.

“No, your race is just an eyesore right now.” Amethyst said.

“Same.” Snowdragon said.

“Me too.” Till Ancestor spat out blood and uttered coldly.
